title: curated_saju_joint_input_row_v1
description: Input line contract for data/myeongni/curated_saju_joint_v1.jsonl (ingest_curated_saju_joint_v1.py). At least one of provenance_url, source_url, or source_citation must be non-empty.

expectations.description: Forwarded to sasang_saju_joint_benchmark_row_v1.expectations. For celebrity/state probes: expectations.state_id (1–16) must match measured myeongni_16state_probe_nearest_v1.nearest_state_id from run_saju_global_birth_v1 + myeongri_core_v2_upgrade (L2 vs data/myeongni/16_STATE_MASTER_PROBE_v1); arbitrary IDs fail run_myeongni_celebrity_benchmark_v1.

state_id.description: Nearest 16-state master probe id — must equal engine nearest_state_id, not hand-picked.

ingest_at_utc.description: Optional ISO-8601 Z — used by check_curated_saju_joint_staleness_v1 for freshness vs hit-rate artifact.
